import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_84/test_0.csv"
]

# List to hold dataframes from all sources
source_dfs = []

# Load each source file
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    source_dfs.append(df)

# Concatenate all source dataframes (in this case only one)
combined_df = pd.concat(source_dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Transformation:
# From source schema ['V_CALL'] to target schema ['V_GENE']
# Remove the allele part after '*' in V_CALL to get V_GENE
combined_df['V_GENE'] = combined_df['V_CALL'].str.split('*').str[0]

# Select only the target column
target_df = combined_df[['V_GENE']]

# Write the transformed data to the target CSV file
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_84/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)
